title: Chapter 472: Alliance Between The Roland Empire And The Mali Dynasty
content:
Chapter 472: Alliance Between The Roland Empire And The Mali Dynasty

"Evil son, after you go back, confine me for three years. Sooner or later, I will be killed by you."

The Lord of Sifang City was considering whether to train another trumpet at this time, after all, he had many concubines.

Wang Shuo returned to Wana City and arranged the people of the Ye family in a small town.

As for Ye Xueer, of course, she lived in the palace built in Wana City.

One day, Guliji came to see Wang Shuo with important information.

"Your Majesty, I received a spy report that the Roland Empire and the Mali Dynasty have entered into an alliance."

Wang Shuo was quite shocked when he heard the news.

This move by the two countries was obviously aimed at the Wana Empire.

The number of kings in the Wana Empire was exceeding theirs, which made them a little uneasy, so they thought of forming an alliance to fight against the Wana Empire together.

Wang Shuo immediately summoned the ministers to discuss.

Zhao Bangde immediately said: "Your Majesty, the alliance between the two countries will inevitably attack our country. We should prepare in advance."

"The national teacher is right, but we may send envoys to test it out and see if we can split their alliance."

Prime Minister Zhu Dongheng pondered.

Wang Shuo nodded after hearing this.

The strength of the Wana Empire has reached the point where it can compete with them, which is not at all weak, but if you want to go to war, you still have to use courtesy before force.

Development is the hard truth. As long as you are strong, any means will be futile.

Wang Shuo immediately sent Duan Wenxi as a diplomatic envoy to the two countries.

On the other hand, Wang Shuo asked Ayub to clean up the army.

A few days ago, Ayub finally succeeded in becoming the strongest king.

The big stone in Wang Shuo's heart finally fell.

Former tool people like Gong Zheng and Ayub have also recovered their memories.

In the past few years, Wang Shuo has treated everyone well, and everyone has worked hard for the empire.

Ten days later, Wang Shuo decided to hold a grand military parade.

He hadn't inspected his army for a long time. Showing up from time to time would make the army more cohesive.

...

After receiving Wang Shuo's order, Ayub quickly prepared.

Today is different from the past. The number of troops in the Wana Empire has reached 8 million.

Ayub only selected 1 million people who could participate in the military parade, including 400,000 monsters and the rest were human.

On the high platform, Wang Shuo and a group of senior officials sat down.

In the square below, the various legions were arranged in order.

Today, the legions of the Wana Empire mainly include the Golden Fire Cavalry directly under Ayub, 50,000 people.

Gong Zheng's Rock Shield Guards are 50,000 people, Ye Tianba is in charge, and Wang Shuo's Hell Knights are 50,000 people.

Goode's archers, Li Jianguo's crossbow battalion, Gong Kai's archery battalion, Li Weiguo's city defense army, Xie Xiaofeng's...

Ayub handed over the monster troops to Lin Dabiao, Liu Zhiming and Zhang Yang.

Almost every commander has a main force of 50,000 people under his command, plus a number of reserves.

The weapons and equipment are the most advanced at present, and the army is in full bloom.

A strong sense of pride rose in Wang Shuo's heart.

As long as all the commanders become the strongest kings, the Wana Empire will be invincible.

But the idea is beautiful, but the reality is a bit cruel.

The commanders who entered the Tomb of the King became less smooth in the next few months.

Gong Zheng was successfully promoted, but Lin Dabiao, Li Baoguo, Goode, Ba Huoyao and others who were highly expected by Wang Shuo fell in the Tomb of the King.
